town.bsmp.npc.0.text: Welcome to Bosque Village, brave warrior. This once was a forest surrounding a temple, but the temple was destroyed by Jashiin. Now the village of Bosque is desolate. I hope you are here to help us.

town.bsmp.npc.1.text: Listen, stranger, a sentry is posted on the outskirts of the city. I\m telling you this for your own good; it\s best to stay away from there.

town.bsmp.npc.10.text: That sentry must have sold his soul to Jashiin. Why else would he interfere with brave men such as yourself?

town.bsmp.npc.11.text: Hold on there! Do you have the Hero\s Crest?

town.bsmp.npc.12.text: Don\t lie, it won\t do any good. Get out of here!

town.bsmp.npc.13.text: You cannot pass here without the Hero\s Crest. My orders are from the Spirits themselves!

town.bsmp.npc.14.text: Hold on there! You have the Hero\s Crest, I see. You may pass.

town.bsmp.npc.2.text: The temple that once stood here had the crest of the Warrior God carved into it. Winners of the martial arts competitions held in front of the temple were awarded with such crests. Thus the crest, the symbol of a true hero, became known as the Hero\s Crest.

town.bsmp.npc.3.text: When he destroyed the temple, Jashiin stole the Hero\s Crest.  No one has any idea where to find it.

town.bsmp.npc.4.text: The crest must be hidden somewhere in the forest, but I couldn\t say where.

town.bsmp.npc.5.text: When the temple was destroyed I heard Jashiin ordering his underlings to hide the crest in the trunk of the biggest tree. That must be where it is hidden. I hope you can find it.

town.bsmp.npc.6.text: A spirit appeared and told me to say this if I met a brave man: "If you go through the door to the right of the tree that forms a cross, you will be able to go up."/I&hope it helps you.

town.bsmp.npc.7.text: I have some advice for you: Be careful if you come to a place where the leaves of the trees are thin. The ground there is not very strong.

town.bsmp.npc.8.text: The sentry at the edge of town says the Spirits came to him in a dream, and told him not to allow anyone to pass unless they bear the Hero\s Crest. I wonder if the Spirits really ordered such a thing? Perhaps he\s mad.

town.bsmp.npc.9.text: A few have slipped by the sentry undetected, but none have returned. There must be some terrible monster out there.

town.cmap.npc.0.text: If you are the brave warrior we have awaited, we have something to tell you: throughout the ages, many young men have entered the caverns, but few have returned.

town.cmap.npc.1.text: According to legend, there may still be underground places that have not been destroyed by Jashiin. People may still be living there, and will surely lend you a hand.

town.cmap.npc.2.text: I have been in the underground town. After I fled, they put a lock on the door. If the town is still there....

town.cmap.npc.3.text: This is the chamber of poor Princess Felicia, who has been turned to stone. You may enter, Duke Garland.

town.cmap.npc.4.text: Brave knight, you have awakened. When you fell at the hand of Jashiin, the Spirits brought you here. Now make haste to the aid of the Princess Felicia.

town.cmap.npc.6.text: Ah, the Nine Tears of Esmesanti. Jashiin exists no more and the light of peace shines once again on our land...

town.cmap.npc.7.text: This will benefit the people living underground, as well. Hurry to the Princess Felicia.

town.cmap.npc.8.text: The peace we dared not hope for has come. I\ll get my things together and be on my way. I\ve a family to attend to.

town.cmap.npc.9.text: Quickly, enter this chamber. The holy crystals will break the evil spell which has turned Princess Felicia to stone.

town.drmp.npc.0.text: Welcome to Dorado./This was once a thriving merchant town where everyone lived a peaceful life. Jashiin has reduced it to a sad, desolate place.

town.drmp.npc.1.text: The Spirits say that Jashiin returned because the people, made soft by peace and prosperity, sank into corruption.

town.drmp.npc.10.text: When you find green stone slabs that can be moved up and down, arrange them like a staircase so you can go up easily.

town.drmp.npc.11.text: The middle of the caverns is made of pure gold! But there is one fake gold wall that can be destroyed.

town.drmp.npc.12.text: Ah! You found the Shirukaano shoes! Now you can scale any slope.

town.drmp.npc.13.text: Brave lad! A message from the Spirits: Take great care when you enter the next world.

town.drmp.npc.2.text: Using the money and treasures of Dorado and other places, Jashiin built a place of his own. The Tesoro and Burata Caverns are his domain.

town.drmp.npc.3.text: A word to the wise: The door bearing the green symbol cannot be opened. There\s no use trying to force it, it absolutely cannot be opened.

town.drmp.npc.4.text: Somewhere in the caverns are the Shirukaano shoes made by the shoemaker Percel. Try to find them; when you wear those shoes you can climb any slope.

town.drmp.npc.5.text: Someone who went into the caverns told me the Shirukaano shoes are hidden in Tesoro. Of the four rooms in the center, they are in the far right room.

town.drmp.npc.6.text: Of the four doors in Tesoro, three bear a blue symbol. What was the other one? For the life of me I can\t remember.

town.drmp.npc.7.text: This building wasn\t here before, was it? You can\t put up a building like this overnight -- how did it get here?

town.drmp.npc.8.text: A peace statue called \Taruso\ stood here, but one night it disappeared. Where in the world can it have gone? The evil Jashiin must have taken a liking to it.

town.drmp.npc.9.text: I have a message from the Spirits: wait for the moving edge of the platform made of shining blocks.

town.esmp.npc.0.text: Pay attention to the door with the blue symbol. It has turned three colors.

town.esmp.npc.1.text: If you fall from a stone and are blocked by a wall, thrust through it with your sword. If the wall crumbles away you\ll be on the road leading to the abode of Jashiin.

town.esmp.npc.2.text: By jumping in front of the ivy rather than going down it, you can open a new road.

town.esmp.npc.3.text: Look for another door with a blue symbol. If you see it, turn to the right.

town.esmp.npc.4.text: Do you have doubts? Here there is only slaughter and destruction. What do you expect to accomplish?

town.esmp.npc.5.text: Why have the Spirits sent you on this journey of slaughter? Why does Jashiin await you in silence?

town.esmp.npc.6.text: Pay no heed to those two, they are in league with Jashiin. They are trying to weaken your will.

town.hlmp.npc.0.text: Welcome. You must be cold. Helada used to be a warm, prosperous place, but Jashiin has turned it into a cold ruin.

town.hlmp.npc.1.text: You may have noticed that there are two roads leading here. There is also a shortcut.

town.hlmp.npc.10.text: I\ll bet the green slime creatures have caused you a lot of trouble. Let me tell you a secret: they can\t withstand heat. Burn them and they will vanish in a single burst of steam.

town.hlmp.npc.2.text: Have you been in the ice caverns? The shoemaker in this town was trying to make special shoes out of Ruzeria bark, to help a hero walk on the ice. Just as he managed to do so, Jashiin\s minions murdered him. I wonder what happened to those shoes.

town.hlmp.npc.3.text: Are you the brave one? My lover, Percel, was killed by Jashiin\s underlings just after the Spirits asked him to make the Ruzeria shoes for a brave man. Return my Percel to me! Oh, if only you had not come!

town.hlmp.npc.4.text: I think you should know something: Percel the shoemaker said that without the Ruzeria shoes you could not go beyond the green door.

town.hlmp.npc.5.text: Ruzeria is the name of a tree that grows in the underground forest. The bark is very hard and is not slippery. Percel had good reason for choosing it.

town.hlmp.npc.6.text: Someone I know said he had seen a pair of unusual shoes in the caverns. I\m not sure whether those are the shoes that Percel made.

town.hlmp.npc.7.text: I\m sorry for what I said a short while ago. I don\t know what came over me. Please defeat Jashiin and avenge the death of Percel.

town.hlmp.npc.8.text: Ah, the shoes of Percel.... I see you are a brave man. I hope you will find Jashiin and defeat him quickly.

town.hlmp.npc.9.text: This brave man with the Ruzeria shoes... With this the shoemaker\s shop also floats up...

town.llmp.npc.0.text: Help! A terrible creature is in our hut! Please get rid of it for us.

town.llmp.npc.1.text: Oh, thank you, sir. As a token of my gratitude I will give you the Elf Crest. I think you\ll find it useful; without it, no one in town will help you.

town.llmp.npc.10.text: My name is Michael. No one here listens to a word I say. I wonder why that is?

town.llmp.npc.11.text: Oh! You\ve got the Elf Crest. Great!

town.llmp.npc.12.text: Jashiin filled the caverns with a flaming inferno. Please help us, brave lad!

town.llmp.npc.13.text: Beware of the great heat currents. There are many whirlpools in the caverns, and once you get caught in one you\ll never get out.

town.llmp.npc.14.text: There are countless one-way, invisible walls in Correr Cave. To find out more about them, ask Yozeras or Myuuza the elder.

town.llmp.npc.15.text: I am Yozeras. When you go into Correr Cave, watch out for an opening with no ivy. You\ll fall if you go through there.

town.llmp.npc.16.text: I\m  Myuuza, the town elder. If you go into the Correr Cave be sure to remember the color of the entrance door. The exit door is the same color.

town.llmp.npc.17.text: If you can\t find your way, find an air current near the ceiling of the cave. You can transport yourself on those currents.

town.llmp.npc.18.text: Sir, I can see that you don\t have the Elf Crest. Recently some henchmen of Jashiin have been posing as heroes and wreaking havoc on this town. You\re not one of them by any chance, are you? Without the Elf Crest, no one here will speak to you.

town.llmp.npc.3.text: /The caverns in this region are burning hot; you won\t be able to stand it long. I\ve got something that will help you. It\s an Asbestos cape that will protect you from the heat.

town.llmp.npc.4.text: The caverns in this region are burning hot; you won\t be able to stand it long. I\ve got something that will help you. It\s an Asbestos cape that will protect you from the heat.

town.llmp.npc.5.text: It\s not free though. It will cost you 2500&almas.///

town.llmp.npc.6.text: Oh, I&see... well, maybe next time.

town.llmp.npc.7.text: You say you don\t have 2500&almas to give? Don\t try to fool me.

town.llmp.npc.8.text: Here you are. That will be 2500&almas. Take good care of it.

town.llmp.npc.9.text: Are you taking good care of the Asbestos cape? It was my prized possession so I hope you\ll treat it well.

town.mrmp.npc.0.text: Ah, you are the warrior I\ve heard about. My son Michael was a courageous warrior. He went into the caverns and was never seen again. Please be careful.

town.mrmp.npc.1.text: Sir, I dreamed that a demon created the underground caverns and filled them with monsters. Then the Spirits brought you to here to make things right again. Before you go, visit the magic shop -- you\ll find many useful things there. Good luck on your quest.

town.mrmp.npc.2.text: You\re on your way to the caverns, aren\t you? I recently went in search of a powerful potion said to be hidden there. I didn\t stay long enough to find it, but perhaps you will. Be sure to stop at the weapons shop -- you\ll need some strong armor.Duke Garland, they say that a potion is hidden in a wall near a platform that raises and lowers. I&wish you luck.

town.mrmp.npc.3.text: You\re going into the caverns? You are a brave man. They say there are many doors underground, but many are locked and the keys are scattered throughout the labyrinths. I hope you can find them.

town.mrmp.npc.4.text: Duke Garland, someone I know survived a journey to the underground town, Satono. According to him, the road back is short but the road out is long. It will be very dangerous.

town.mrmp.npc.5.text: According to the legends, the name of the underground town is Satono.

town.mrmp.npc.6.text: A moment, Duke Garland. If you listen closely in front of the underground door, you will hear a terrifying sound. That\s the entrance to the inferno that is home to the demons. Beware that place, young man.

town.mrmp.npc.7.text: Alas, I fear there is no hope. You and I and all who inhabit this town will surely perish. Don\t run off to some terrible place, stay and have a drink with me. Ah, I know you must go, and I salute you -- you\re a braver man than I. God be with you.

town.mrmp.npc.8.text: When you kill a&monster you get a&thing called \almas\. It\s worth a&lot of money. I\d like to get some myself but I don\t want to go down there.

town.prmp.npc.0.text: Fooled again! Meddlesome fool! Taste the past and never return here again. /HA, HA, HA, HA...

town.prmp.npc.1.text: Are you from the outside world? Welcome. You are certainly a courageous man guided by the Spirits.

town.prmp.npc.10.text: I\ve heard that the lion\s head key fell between two towers under a stone slab. It is supposedly near this town.

town.prmp.npc.12.text: Beware of Jashiin\s last henchman, Algaien. It is said that Jashiin used his power to give him eternal life.

town.prmp.npc.2.text: A moment, sir. I have seen the fortress of Jashiin. It is at the edge of this world. The Spirits guided me back from there alive so I could tell you about it.

town.prmp.npc.3.text: I think you should know that this town is very close to the fortress of Jashiin, and his henchmen are sure to be around. Be careful.

town.prmp.npc.4.text: YOU! The princess you struggle to rescue will lead you to your doom! The Spirits are just demons in disguise. What does this mean? You do the devil\s work, you must be the devil!  WA, HA, HA, HA, HA...

town.prmp.npc.5.text: The Spirits gave me a lion\s head key but it was stolen by one of Jashiin\s underlings. I hope you will find it on your travels.

town.prmp.npc.6.text: Ah, yes -- that\s the key that was entrusted to me by the Spirits. Make good use of it.

town.prmp.npc.7.text: I pray for your safe return.

town.prmp.npc.8.text: The one weapon you\ll need to defeat Jashiin is the Fairy Flame Sword. According to legend it gives off a peculiar light and can vanquish any foe with only one blow. However, where it is to be found is another matter...

town.prmp.npc.9.text: Nearby is a village called Esko, but I don\t know what has happened to it recently. I once knew many people there.

town.stmp.npc.0.text: Welcome, stranger. You must have come through the labyrinths from the outside world. We have not encountered such a brave person in a very long time. You should visit the great sage Yasmin -- she will be anxious to meet you.

town.stmp.npc.1.text: So you\re the brave one I\ve heard about. Well, if you\re going to go on from here, I\ll give you a tip.  When you come to a stopping place, dig a hole. The demons have hidden jewels in many places.

town.stmp.npc.2.text: Are you Duke Garland? Thank the Spirits you\ve come. We escaped from Jashiin through the power of the Spirits. However, if his power should become so strong that the Spirits\ can\t protect us, this town is doomed.

town.stmp.npc.3.text: Let me give you some advice, stranger. If you fall down the stone slab in front of the blue door, you will see a green door nearby. Don\t go through that door under any circumstances -- it is a doorway to the past.

town.stmp.npc.4.text: Beware! I went into the caverns and saw an awful creature -- a giant demon octopus. It was terrifying, but I escaped. I hope you will be as lucky.

town.stmp.npc.5.text: Are you the brave one? I&hope you have brought almas for us. The almas are part of Jashiin\s power. We use them to make medicine, and other useful things.

town.stmp.npc.6.text: Duke Garland, when you go into the caverns again, please try to bring back more almas. To supplement the protective power of the Spirits we must build a wall of almas. Unless we get more, Satono Town is in peril.

town.tmmp.npc.0.text: Brave sir, I hope you\ve come to help this pitiful town. It was the site of a quiet graveyard before it was decimated by Jashiin.

town.tmmp.npc.1.text: If you\re going back into the caverns, beware the Gelroid. It\s a blue gelatinous substance which will suck the life out of you.

town.tmmp.npc.10.text: Isn\t that the Crest of Glory? Please take it quickly to the owner of the weapons store.

town.tmmp.npc.2.text: Have you heard of Percel the shoemaker from Herada Town? He made Ruzeria shoes for walking on ice and Pirika shoes for getting by Gelroid, thorns and fire. Those are the only two I know of, but there may have been more.

town.tmmp.npc.3.text: May I confide in you? I was once a spy for Jashiin. I can tell you that the Pirika shoes were put into a box and thrown away somewhere in the Rotten land. You may never find them.

town.tmmp.npc.4.text: One third of this region is covered with deadly Gelroid. If you\re going to continue through the labyrinths, ordinary shoes will not protect you.

town.tmmp.npc.5.text: There is a certain place in the caverns where you can pass through a wall, but only in one direction. My grandfather told me the place is near a green stone slab. There may be other places, but I couldn\t say where.

town.tmmp.npc.6.text: Have you seen the strange, bluish-white people in the caverns? They were infected by the Gelroid and now they wander the land like the living dead. To kill them, aim for the head.

town.tmmp.npc.7.text: It seems that Jashiin has stolen many things. The weapon maker is searching for his family crest, the Crest of Glory. If you find it in the caverns, he\ll be most happy to have it back.

town.tmmp.npc.8.text: Those are the Pirika shoes. Go quickly to the abode of Jashiin and finish him off. We will pray for your success and swift return.

town.tmmp.npc.9.text: Ah, the Pirika shoes! Forgive me, brave sir. I had no choice. I won\t do that kind of thing again.

inn.name: The Inn
inn.welcomeP1:
Welcome, sir!
You look like you've come a long way.
One night of rest in my inn is all you need to recover your strength. You can have the best room in the house for only
inn.leave:
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
Well, if you should ever need a place to rest, do come back.
inn.noFunds:
I'm sorry sir, but I can't accommodate you without funds.
Please come back when you can afford it.
inn.thankYou: Thank you, sir. Enjoy your stay.
inn.morning: I trust you had a good night's sleep. We'll be looking forward to seeing you again.

bank.name: The Bank
bank.notUnderstood: I don't understand. Please state your business clearly.
bank.thankYouComeAgain: Thank you. Come again to make a deposit for a large sum in savings.
bank.nextTimeLargeSum: Next time please deposit a large sum in savings.
bank.unlessBusiness: Unless you have business, don't come in here. I'm a busy man.
bank.noAlmas: Sir, you aren't carrying any almas.
bank.exchangeRate:
Our exchange rate is {from} almas to {to} golds.
Will that be all right?
bank.notEnoughAlmas: I'm sorry, you do not have enough almas.
bank.noGoldCarried: You aren't carrying any gold, are you?
bank.howMuchDeposit: How much gold would you like to deposit?
bank.noGoldInAccount: I'm afraid we have a problem here. You don't have any gold in your account.
bank.howMuchWithdraw: How much do you wish to withdraw?
bank.notEnoughBankGold: I'm afraid we have a problem here. You don't have enough gold in your account.
bank.notEnoughGold: I'm sorry, you do not have enough gold.
bank.oneGoldAccount: You have one gold in your account.
bank.hereYouAreOne: Here you are, sir. One gold.
bank.youHaveGoldAccount: You have {amount} golds in your account.

church.name: The Church
church.tired: Brave Knight, whenever you're tired come to this church.
church.weary: Brave Knight, whenever you're weary, come here to rest.
church.holy: The Holy Spirit will help you to regain your strength.
church.fatigued: Brave Knight, you look fatigued from battle. Why not rest awhile and let the Spirit heal you.

king.name: King of Felishika
king.goldGiftLine: I hereby bestow upon you 1000 Golds.
firstAudience: Brave Duke Garland, you'll need money for your journey.
I hereby bestow upon you 1000 Golds.
Go to town and outfit yourself, then make haste to the labyrinth to defeat the forces of Jashiin.
My kingdom and the life of my daughter are at stake.
reminder: Brave Duke, did you forget something?
The entrance to the labyrinth is at the edge of town.
Please hurry, before it's too late!
afterCavern: Duke Garland, I am in debt to you for your efforts.
Have you not yet succeeded in vanquishing Jashiin?
I pray that the spirits will guide you.
Please don't give up, the people of Zeliard are depending on you!
victory: Duke Garland, you are a brave man.
You have conquered Jashiin and returned the nine Tears of Esmesanti.
Now go quickly to the chamber of Princess Felicia.
The crystals will bring her back to life.

weaponShop.name: Weapon and Armour Shop
itemDescriptions: Well, I'd say this sword is all right for a beginner. You get what you pay for. It's your standard, maintenance-free sword. If money's a problem, this one's for you.
This one is just a bit better than the Training Sword. Once you get the hang of it, it's an easy one to wield. The price is a bit higher, but you can't lose on this one. Why not take it with you?
You like this one? A wise choice. This is a high grade product. It's one of my biggest sellers.
Oh, I'd be more than happy to tell you about this one. This is a real man's sword. It'll topple monsters in the wink of an eye.
You've got a lot of grit I'd say. This one really packs a punch. A top-of-the-line sword for a top-of-the-line swordsman. Will you take it?
Isn't that the sword you brought in with you?
This shield is small and has limited defense capability. It's not very durable -- unless it's used with great skill, it won't last long. It's better than nothing, I guess.
Well, it's slightly better than the Clay Shield. Long ago, a well-known hero used it for a short time. You could do a lot worse.
This one is more of a general-use shield. It's not the best one I carry. I can't really recommend it, I think it will soon be obsolete.
This shield is in a class by itself. It is strong and light and easy to use. This is a superior shield, the least a brave man should have.
Ho! You've got quite an eye for these things, I see. This shield is not made of common iron. It is made of a magic metal called Magane. Against ordinary weapons, it's unbreakable.
This shield makes the mightiest swords seem like paper. It's light as a feather and hard as a diamond. Used well, this one will last you a lifetime.
weaponShop.greeting: May I be of service, sir?
weaponShop.crestTradeIntro: Well I'll be... Sir! Isn't that the crest of honor you bear? Please come in... I mean... uh... Might I trade you a knight's sword for it?
weaponShop.crestTradeQuestion: Might I trade you a knight's sword for it?
weaponShop.noShield: Sir, you aren't carrying a shield -- however, I do have a fine selection, if you'd like to buy one.
weaponShop.shieldNotDamaged: Sir, your shield is not in need of repair. How else can I help you?
weaponShop.repairOffer: I'll be glad to repair your shield, sir, for the low price of {cost} golds. Shall I proceed?
weaponShop.notEnoughGold: I'm sorry sir, you aren't carrying enough gold. Perhaps after you've visited the bank...
weaponShop.waitMoment: Please wait here, I'll only be a moment.
weaponShop.repairsComplete: The repairs to your armour are complete. It is now as good as new.
weaponShop.noWeaponsInStock: I'm sorry, I have no weapons in stock at the moment.
weaponShop.noShieldsInStock: I'm sorry, I have no shields in stock at the moment.
weaponShop.notSellingKnightSword: I do not sell that weapon. I haven't a single one in stock. Please choose another.
weaponShop.priceOffer: Oh, the {item}! That will be {price} golds.
weaponShop.tradeInLine: I'll give you {amount} golds on your old {kind} as a trade-in.
weaponShop.somethingElse: Will there be something else for you, sir?
weaponShop.nothingToShow: I'm afraid I have nothing to show you at the moment.
weaponShop.explainIntro: All of my goods are of the highest quality. Which item would you like me to tell you about?
weaponShop.wasteTime: If you're going to waste my time, please be on your way.
weaponShop.crestTradeThanks: Oh, thank you, sir! As promised, here is your knight's sword. It's the finest weapon I have. Use it well.

magicShop.name: Witchcraft Implement Shop
itemDescriptions: Well, it's a special blend of yunkel fruit and ripodi leaf. It's low in price and as a mild health tonic, it's perfect.

This is the fruit of the Juu-en tree which bears only once every ten years. The price is a bit high, but it provides excellent relief from wounds and exhaustion -- it's quite a bit better than the Ken'ko potion.
This potion is made from the broth of mistletoe simmered on the night of a full moon. It restores magical powers. It's very bitter, but the price is low.
This is made from a mixture of the powdered dragon scales and crushed Wise Man's Stone steamed for one hundred days. It will fully restore your magical powers. The price, however... is high.
This stone protects the aura that living beings exude. It surrounds the aura to prevent interference from other auras and acts as a protection against enemy attacks.
This is a liquified metal made from mercury and iron. If you paint it on a shield weakened by battle, the shield will regain its original strength.
Hmm... I don't know much about this one, but I do know that it increases the offensive power of a sword. Don't worry, it hasn't killed anyone yet.
This feather remembers the voice of the last wise man who spoke to you. If you hold it in your right hand and swing it once, you'll return to him. It's never failed anyone I know.
magicShop.greeting: Oh... hello, can I help you?
magicShop.noThanks: Is there something I can do for you?
magicShop.goOutside: Thank you, sir. Please come again.
magicShop.buyOffer: You'd like a {item}. That will be {price} golds. Will there be something else?
magicShop.noSpace: You can't possibly carry any more.
magicShop.buyDone: That will be... Will there be something else?
magicShop.notCarryingItems: You aren't carrying any magic items, sir.
magicShop.whatToSell: What would you like to sell?
magicShop.sellOffer: You'd like to sell a {item}. I'll give you {price} golds for that. Will that be all right?
magicShop.whichItem: Which item can I tell you about?

sage.name: The Sage
intros:
I am the Sage Marid.
You are very brave to embark on such a dangerous journey. I shall assist you in your travels.

I am the Sage Yasmin.
I have been expecting you. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Throwing Swords: Espada.

I am the Sage Hajjar.
I am happy to see you've made it this far. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Arrows: Saeta.

I am the Sage Chiriga.
You have come far, and you must be cold. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Fire: Fuego.

I am the Sage Hisham.
You are doing well to stand before me. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Flame: Lanzar.

I am the Sage Maryam.
You have made the Spirits proud with your bravery. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Falling Rocks: Rascar.

I am the Sage Saied.
You have lived through much, but your journey is not over. You must be hot. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Water: Agua.

I am the Sage of All Sages, Indihar.
Brave lad, you've done well to get this far.
I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Lightning: Guerra.
knowledge: My master, the Sage Yasmin, resides in the underground town. She is a person you can turn to if you are in need.
When you leave the city, climb to the plateau on the left. You'll see a door that looks like the exit from this world.
The exit from this world is very near the exit from the village. However, before you go there you must have the Hero's Crest.
This is a message from the Spirits: Bend when you walk a low road. Walk not on the steep path with the needles of ice, choose another path instead. Heed well these words.
You can't defeat the demons at the edge of the badlands without the Knight's Sword. Until you get that sword, do not open the door of the demons.
Once you leave this world, get the Silkarn shoes made by the spirits at the behest of Percel. If you do not get those, you cannot travel far from this world.
That world is controlled by dragons. To get there, you have to open three closed doors.

At the edge of this world is the final foe, Jashiin.
To fight Jashiin, you must have the Sword of the Fairy Flame. And to get there, you must topple the invincible monster Alguien.

While you were unconscious, the spirits brought you here.
Be careful not to exhaust yourself in battle.
Now be on your way. The spirits are looking after you.

demonSpeechLines: and once again reign over the world.
balconyPart1: Once, long ago, a terrible storm came to the land of Zeliard.
Dark clouds filled the sky; lightning flashed and thunder crashed.
Day after day, rain poured from the heavens as if in lament.
On the seventh day of rain, a beautiful young girl stood on her balcony watching this dark, sad rain.
The girl was Princess Felicia la Felishika.  She was the only daughter of King Felishika, and the light of his life.
Her smiles were like sunshine, her voice as beautiful as that of an angel.  She was adored by the people of the kingdom.
"What a dreadful storm!  Will it never end?"
Just as the princess spoke these words, the raindrops turned to grains of sand which covered the ground below her.
balconyPart2: As she watched, a startling transformation began to take place.
In an instant, the green hills and plains turned a dusty brown.
Trees and flowers crumpled and were buried.
Rivers and lakes disappeared beneath the sand.
This ever-green land was turning to desert before her very eyes.
princessDemon: "How can this be?" she cried, "What evil power could cause such a terrible thing to happen?"
princessVsDemon: Princess Felicia shivered as she felt a dark presence near her, and suddenly, a terrifying voice bellowed as loud as thunder...
"I am Jashiin, the Emperor of Chaos.  The descendants of those who imprisoned me under the earth shall know that my wrath has smoldered for two thousand years!"
demonFinal: "Beautiful Princess Felicia, you will make a lovely and terrifying symbol of my awakening.  Your father will not make the mistakes of his ancestors!"
As the words of the demon resounded over the land, Princess Felicia was turned to stone.
stoned: The rain of sand continued for 108 days and transformed the once-fertile land into desert.
The people of the kingdom wept at the terrible fate of their country, and of their princess.
kingPrincess: The King wept most of all. "Oh, my beloved Felicia!  I fear the Age of Darkness is upon us.  I am powerless to stop it ... and powerless to help you."
But the tears of the King and his people soon awakened another power.
As the King grieved, an apparition appeared before him.
spirit: "I am the Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard.  The demon Jashiin has been resurrected, and indeed his evil magic will plunge this world into the Age of Darkness once again."
"Heed my words, King Felishika: There is but one way to stop this demon.  A brave warrior must venture into the labyrinths and recover the nine Holy Crystals, the Tears of Esmesanti."
"Many terrible creatures dwell within the labyrinths, all of them Jashiin's minions.  No mortal man could defeat these deadly beasts and wrest the crystals from them."
"However, there is one with the power to oppose Jashiin. The man who is destined to fight him will soon arrive in your kingdom."
"This man is the only being strong enough to banish Jashiin forever."

"You must await the arrival of this brave and noble knight, and tell him everything.  Only with his help can you hope to restore this land to its former beauty, and free your daughter from her terrible curse."
Having spoken these words, the Spirit disappeared.
kingSurprised: King Felishika could not believe what he had seen.  "Surely my mind is playing tricks on me!  I'm afraid I have gone mad with grief."
But the next day, a stranger appeared in the kingdom...
dukeArrived: "What a desolate place!  Why has the Spirit led me here?"
Guided by the light of the Spirit, brave Duke Garland had journeyed many days to the land of Zeliard.
dukeEscorted: Entering the castle, he was quickly escorted to the throne of the grieving King Felishika.
kingDuke1: "Duke Garland!  You must be the man of destiny of whom the Spirit spoke.  I beg of you to destroy the demon Jashiin who has cursed my kingdom and turned my beloved daughter to stone."
kingDuke2: Duke Garland knelt before the King.  "Your Majesty, I have followed the light of the Spirit to this place."
"I know not of this demon, nor what powers he may possess, but if there is none else who can defeat him, then I will dedicate my life to this task."
kingDuke3: "For the first time since the sandstorm began, you have brought hope into my heart, Duke Garland.  May God go with you on your quest."
finalScroll: the door of destiny was opened.
in dethroning the Emperor of Chaos?
jashiinWindow: Suddenly, the room grew cold.  A black mist swirled around them, then took on a hideous shape.
"Are you the fool who dares to challenge me?  Don't be absurd!"
dukeVsJashiinDuke1: "And you must be the evil Jashiin!"
dukeVsJashiinJashiin1: "You shall address me as the Emperor of Chaos... THE EMPEROR OF CHAOS!"
"Young fool, I could destroy you now, but I need a little amusement.  I will give you some time to perform your little quest, but you must promise not to bore me."
"Of course, you have no hope of defeating me."
dukeVsJashiinDuke2: "Mark my words, evil one: I will not stop until I have reclaimed the nine holy crystals, and sealed you under the earth once and for all!"
dukeVsJashiinJashiin2: The demon laughed, and the sound was like breaking glass.
"My labyrinths are immense, and run deep into the earth.  You'll soon lose your way, and then my underlings will finish you off."
"It's been many years since a stray mortal has wandered into their realm. They are hungry for human flesh."
With that, Jashiin disappeared leaving echoes of earsplitting laughter.
dukePromise: "You haven't seen the last of me, Jashiin! Your reign of evil is near its end!"

dukePrincess: At long last, Jashiin was destroyed and the nine Tears of Esmesanti were returned to their rightful place.
Princess Felicia was restored to her true form.
"You are as beautiful as a rose in bloom!"
"You have done a great deed in defeating Jashiin.  Although my body was here, my soul was with the Holy Spirit, watching you."
"I don't know how to thank you for rescuing me and saving my country."
kingPrincess: "My darling Felicia!  How I've longed to hold you in my arms and hear your sweet voice!"
Outside, the land cursed by the evil magic of Jashiin began to resume its original lushness.
The dreadful power of Jashiin was washed from the earth, and the land of Zeliard was peaceful once more.
spirit: The Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard appeared before Duke Garland once again.
"You have suffered many hardships to defeat Jashiin, Duke Garland."
dukeSpirit: "You fought bravely to accomplish this quest.  But this was only the beginning.  Your next mission awaits you in a new land."
"There are many who have need of your special talents.  Follow me and I will show you the way.  We must depart quickly."
There was no time to rest, and no time to stay in this peaceful land.
princess1: "Must you leave so soon, Duke Garland?
"Princess Felicia, I must bid you farewell.  Morning is coming soon, and I will miss the light of Spirit unless I start before the dawn."
The Duke answered quickly, as if to head off the next words of Princess Felicia.
farewellPart1: For if he heard those words, he might not be able to leave, as he knew he must.  He turned and walked away...
farewellPart2: Duke Garland left the castle, and he felt as if his heart might break.
As she watched him go, Princess Felicia said to herself,
"He will return.  The road to his destiny, began here, and it shall end here."
"When his work in the world is done, he'll come back to me.  Until then, I can only believe it, and wait for him."
